title: From a claim to evidence: the path from repository to live URL
takeaway: Nobody will clone and run your project; getting it live means getting secrets, config and the database right on the way.
sources: A portfolio project that is not deployed is a claim.
This is the one that actually hurts, and it happens to people who know better.
Deleting the file does not help - it is in the history, and history is public.
An empty app is worse than no app.
